message: The other day, my kids decided it was the perfect time to have a mini cooking competition while I was trying to prep dinner. I could feel my heart racing as I reminded them about kitchen safety and keeping an eye on the stove. 😅 It was a good reminder for me too—having a family escape plan is just as important as those smoke alarms. It’s all about teamwork, right? How do you keep your little chefs safe in the kitchen?
